sents.en: There are many kinds of automobiles.
An automobile is a car.
Cars replaced the horse and buggy.
People called early cars horseless carriages.
sents.ko: 사람들은 초기 자동차를 '말 없는 마차'라고 불렀어요.

sents.en: The Model T was built in 1908.
It was the first popular car.
Most people could afford to buy it.
sents.ko: 대부분의 사람이 살 수 있는 값이었어요.

sents.en: The first cars had cranks.
Turning the crank started the car.
Now people turn a key.
Gas is the most common fuel for cars.
sents.ko: 기름은 자동차에 가장 많이 쓰는 연료예요.

sents.en: Gas is burned in the car's engine.
Some cars run on electricity.
They get plugged in to recharge.
Cars are made in factories.
The factories have assembly lines.
Cars didn't always have seat belts.
sents.ko: 자동차에 처음부터 안전벨트가 있던 건 아니에요.

sents.en: They became standard in the 1960s.
Jenny always uses her seat belt.
A car might stop working.
Jose helps his dad fix their car.
sents.ko: 호세는 아빠가 차를 고치는 걸 도와요.

sents.en: Wow! Vroom, vroom.
If I had a car, I would drive to the beach or the mountain.
sents.ko: 저에게 자동차가 있다면 바다나 산으로 갈 거예요.

sents.en: If you had a car, where would you want to go?
sents.ko: 여러분에게 자동차가 있다면 어디에 가고 싶나요?

sents.en: I'd like to know.
We should go on a trip together.
See you next time.
